title: Wronged: A Story of the Dark
author: J.A. Sutherland
note: conf=0.9; Short story set in the Alexis Carew universe, following Jon Bartlett, set ~30 years before Into the Dark and intended to be read after The Little Ships (#3). Goodreads catalogues it as Alexis Carew #3.5; the EPUB's "#301" is the publisher's Kindle side-story numbering (compare Planetfall listed as "Alexis Carew Book 101"). A portion of it was later expanded into the novel Spacer (Spacer, Smuggler, Pirate, Spy #1, 2018).
